description: Hand-labelled synthetic DMS smoke set; 30 passages, 60 queries (English, Spanish, Catalan); one relevant passage per query. Not MTEB or a production quality estimate.

documents.title: Paid electricity invoice
documents.text: Electricity invoice INV-2026-091 for the Madrid office, September 2026. Amount EUR 245.80 including VAT. Paid in full by bank transfer on 3 October. No balance outstanding.

documents.title: Outstanding electricity invoice
documents.text: Electricity invoice INV-2026-092 for the Barcelona office, September 2026. EUR 312.40 including VAT. Payment is due on 20 October; the invoice remains unpaid.

documents.title: Supplier credit note
documents.text: The electricity supplier issued a EUR 75 credit note correcting an overcharge on a prior invoice. This is a refund adjustment, not a new bill or a receipt for payment.

documents.title: Rail travel reimbursement
documents.text: Employee Ana travelled from Madrid to Valencia by train for a customer meeting. Rail fare EUR 84.50. Approved business travel expense; reimburse through payroll after submission of the ticket.

documents.title: Client dinner receipt
documents.text: Ana hosted a dinner with a customer in Valencia. Meal receipt EUR 84.50. The entertainment expense requires the attendee list and manager approval before reimbursement.

documents.title: Annual leave policy
documents.text: Employees receive 25 paid working days of annual holiday. Request holiday through the HR portal at least two weeks before the start date. Unused days may be carried over until March.

documents.title: Parental leave policy
documents.text: After a birth or adoption, employees may take parental leave under the applicable national employment rules. Contact HR with the expected date and supporting documents. This is separate from annual holiday.

documents.title: Sickness absence procedure
documents.text: If illness prevents work, tell your manager on the first day. Submit a medical certificate for absences longer than three days. Do not book sick days as annual vacation.

documents.title: Office tenancy agreement
documents.text: The Madrid office lease runs until 31 December 2027. Monthly rent EUR 1800. Either party must give six months written notice before expiry to prevent automatic renewal.

documents.title: Vehicle lease agreement
documents.text: Company vehicle leasing runs for 36 months with a limit of 20000 kilometres per year. Excess mileage costs EUR 0.12 per kilometre. Early termination incurs remaining instalments.

documents.title: Mutual confidentiality agreement
documents.text: Both parties must protect shared commercial information for five years after disclosure. The mutual NDA excludes public information and independently developed knowledge. No intellectual property is transferred.

documents.title: Software ownership clause
documents.text: Under this development services contract, the client owns bespoke source code after full payment. The supplier retains its pre-existing libraries and grants a perpetual licence to those components.

documents.title: Account sign-in security
documents.text: All staff accounts require multifactor authentication. Lost security keys must be reported to IT; identity verification is required before registering a replacement. Password resets alone do not bypass MFA.

documents.title: Backup restoration runbook
documents.text: Encrypted backups run nightly and are retained for 30 days. To recover accidentally deleted documents, IT restores a backup into an isolated environment and verifies the requested files before importing them.

documents.title: Records retention schedule
documents.text: Finance invoices must be retained for six years. Personnel files are retained for the statutory employment period. At expiry, approved deletion removes records and follows the backup retention schedule.

documents.title: Workspace permission guide
documents.text: A workspace owner grants roles to groups. Read access permits published documents; draft access also permits unpublished revisions. Confidential collections use their own exclusive permission scope.

documents.title: Laptop procurement policy
documents.text: Employees may order a laptop up to EUR 1500 with manager approval. Purchases exceeding that ceiling require finance sign-off. Equipment is recorded in the asset register.

documents.title: Equipment return procedure
documents.text: Return defective laptops to the supplier within 30 days of delivery with the original invoice. Request replacement or refund. Normal wear after this period is handled through the warranty process.

documents.title: Hardware warranty terms
documents.text: Computers carry a three-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Accidental damage and normal wear are excluded. Repairs require the serial number and proof of purchase.

documents.title: Approved budget meeting minutes
documents.text: At the October finance committee meeting, members approved the 2027 operating budget. The signed minutes record the adopted EUR 420000 expenditure ceiling and the vote.

documents.title: Draft budget proposal
documents.text: The proposed 2027 operating budget totals EUR 450000. It is a draft pending committee review. These figures have not been approved and must not be treated as spending authority.

documents.title: Delivery confirmation
documents.text: The courier delivered purchase order PO-783 to the Barcelona office on 7 October. The delivery note bears the recipient's signature. Delivery does not establish that the supplier invoice was paid.

documents.title: Supplier payment confirmation
documents.text: Bank remittance for purchase order PO-783: EUR 2350 transferred on 9 October. The bank confirmation establishes payment to the supplier; it is not a delivery note.

documents.title: VAT invoice checklist
documents.text: A valid VAT invoice includes the supplier's tax identifier, invoice number, issue date, taxable amount, VAT rate and tax amount. A card payment slip alone is insufficient to deduct input VAT.

documents.title: Remote working agreement
documents.text: Staff may work remotely two days per week with team approval. Use the company VPN for access to internal systems. Remote working outside the country requires prior HR authorization.

documents.title: Personal data incident procedure
documents.text: Report a suspected personal data breach to the privacy officer immediately. Preserve evidence and do not notify external parties independently. The officer assesses regulatory notification deadlines.

documents.title: Marketing consent record
documents.text: Customer Marta opted in to promotional email on 12 June. She withdrew consent on 2 September. Marketing must suppress further promotional messages while retaining evidence of withdrawal.

documents.title: Document export procedure
documents.text: To export records, choose the permitted collection and download a content package. The package contains document files and metadata. Access checks limit exports to readable entries.

documents.title: Searchable scanned documents
documents.text: The photo-to-PDF workflow runs OCR on scanned page images and adds invisible selectable text. A scan without this text layer may look readable but cannot be searched by its words.

documents.title: Published document revisions
documents.text: Editing a published item creates a draft head revision. Readers continue to see the published revision until the new draft is published. Draft readers can inspect both surfaces.
